user.title: Hungarian transport
user.description: Enable the Hungarian transport card and MÁV ELVIRA service. Optionally add your BKK Open Data key ({url}): cards then reach BKK FUTÁR through Home Assistant, and the key stays out of dashboard configs.

reauth_confirm.title: BKK key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: BKK FUTÁR rejected the stored key. Enter a new one, or leave it empty to remove FUTÁR access. Free key: {url}

abort.single_instance_allowed: Hungarian transport is already set up.
abort.already_configured: Hungarian transport is already set up.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach BKK FUTÁR. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: BKK FUTÁR refuses this key for now: too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.

elvira_between.name: Get MÁV departures
elvira_between.description: Fetch MÁV timetable and mandatory seat reservation information between two stations. When MÁV ELVIRA cannot be reached, the response has no departures and an error: elvira_unavailable (MÁV is down) or elvira_rate_limited (too many requests from this Home Assistant; the next refresh tries again).

origin_code.name: Origin station code
origin_code.description: Nine-digit MÁV station code for the origin.

dest_code.name: Destination station code
dest_code.description: Nine-digit MÁV station code for the destination.

minutes_after.name: Look-ahead time
minutes_after.description: How many minutes ahead to include departures.

dest_name.name: Destination name
dest_name.description: Optional display name for the destination.

futar.name: BKK FUTÁR request
futar.description: Call a BKK FUTÁR endpoint with the key stored in the integration. Used by the dashboard card. When there is no answer, the response has no data and an error: futar_auth (BKK rejected the stored key; update it in the integration options), futar_unavailable (BKK FUTÁR is down), futar_rate_limited (too many requests from this Home Assistant, or BKK refused them as too many for the key; the next refresh tries again) or futar_bad_request (a parameter is invalid, such as one longer than 256 characters; the request was not sent).

rebuild_mav_index.name: Rebuild MÁV route index
rebuild_mav_index.description: Build the train route index from /config/hungarian-transport/mav-gtfs.zip and check every trip against it.

invalid_station_code.message: {field} must be a nine-digit MÁV station code, got "{value}".

same_station.message: Origin and destination must be different stations.

mav_source_missing.message: No MÁV GTFS at {path}. MÁV publishes it to registered users only; put the downloaded zip there.

mav_build_failed.message: The MÁV route index could not be built: {error}

not_loaded.message: Hungarian transport is disabled or not loaded. Enable its integration entry first.

init.title: Hungarian transport options
init.description: BKK Open Data key: cards without their own key use this one through Home Assistant. The stored key is not shown: leave the field empty to keep it, or tick the box to remove it. Free key: {url}

data.daily_mav_index: Daily MÁV route index from GitHub

data_description.daily_mav_index: Once a day, fetch the train route index the project builds from MÁV's newest timetable (from bator.github.io) when it is newer than the one in use. A newer local MÁV feed still wins. Turn it off to keep the weekly release's index and make no such request.
data_description.daily_time: Local time of the daily check for a new MÁV route index (up to 5 minutes later, to spread the requests). It also runs once 10–20 minutes after Home Assistant starts.
data_description.notify_updates: A persistent notification when a new daily MÁV route index is installed, when an update of the integration ships new Volán, city or MÁV timetables, and once when the daily MÁV index fails on 3 days in a row.
data_description.notify_service: Optional. Pick a script or notify service from the list, or type another one as domain.service (for example script.ertesit or notify.mobile_app_iphone). Called with title and message along with each persistent notification. “— none —” or an empty field: persistent notifications only.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach BKK FUTÁR. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: BKK FUTÁR refuses this key for now: too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
error.remove_and_new_key: Either type a new key or tick the box to remove the stored one, not both.
error.invalid_service: Write the service as domain.service, for example notify.mobile_app_iphone.
error.service_not_found: Home Assistant has no such service.

missing_assets.title: Frontend assets missing
missing_assets.description: Hungarian transport found no card files at `{path}`. The source tree has none; install the release zip (HACS or the hungarian-transport.zip asset of a GitHub release) and restart Home Assistant.

mav_build_failed.title: MÁV route index not built
mav_build_failed.description:
The MÁV route index could not be built from `{path}`: {error}

Home Assistant does not build this feed again at startup. Put a new feed there (or upload one), or call the `hungarian_transport.rebuild_mav_index` action to try again.
